lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqí nǐ yào chūchāi ma?
lines.english: Are you going on a business trip next week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, going to Beijing for a meeting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zuò fēijī qù háishi zuò gāotiě?
lines.english: Flying or taking the high-speed train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 坐高铁。只要四个小时，很方便。
lines.pinyin: Zuò gāotiě. Zhǐyào sì gè xiǎoshí, hěn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: Taking the high-speed train. Only four hours, very convenient.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Sān tiān. Kāi wán huì jiù huílai.
lines.english: Three days. Come back after the meeting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 找到了。离会议地点很近，走路五分钟。
lines.pinyin: Zhǎodào le. Lí huìyì dìdiǎn hěn jìn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.english: Found one. Very close to the meeting place, five minutes' walk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I hope you have a safe business trip and come back safely!
